newsitem.title: UK: Sears up after H1 results top forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Sears up after H1 results top forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Sears Plc edged higher in early trading on Tuesday after the retailer posted profits that topped analysts' forecasts, traders said.
Sears shares rose 1 1/2p to 98 1/2p by 0730 GMT, with volume topping 1.28 million shares.
Sears said pre-tax pre-exceptional profit rose 3.7 percent to 28.0 million stg for the half year to July 31. Analysts had forecast profits in a range of 23.0 million stg to 27.0 million.
"The results are slightly better than expected but it's been one of the poorest performers in the sector," said one analyst who declined to be named.
"The trading statement is not bad, and things seem to be on an improving trend," he added.
Sears said overall like for like sales in the first five weeks of the second half were up by 6.2 percent.

Analysts said they were particularly encouraged by the improved like for like position at the start of the second half in footwear and mail-order, two divisions which performed poorly in the first half.
Sears said like-for-like footwear sales in the second half were up three percent so far. Home shopping sales are still below last year, but showing a steady recovery from the first half.
